lines.text: She looked at me sideways. Why?
A look that says you are not sure.

data.mean: A look that says you are not sure.
data.define: A look from the corner of your eye showing doubt.

publish.title: What does "side-eye" mean?
publish.value: Side-eye = A look that says you are not sure. Example: "She gave me the side-eye." (casual English).
